definitions: A refusal to work organised by a body of employees as a form of protest, typically in an attempt to gain a concession or concessions from their employer.
A sudden or unexpected hit or attack.
An act of hitting a bowling pin or all the pins with the first ball.
A discovery of a valuable mineral or oil deposit.
A period of good fortune or success.
examples: She got a strike in the first frame.
The gold strike brought many prospectors.
He had a run of good strikes.
